title: Union Budget: structure and process
quote: Largest source = borrowings (24 paise); largest outflow = States' share (22), not interest (20)

boxes.title: Articles & documents
head: Article
Provision
rows: Consolidated Fund, Public Account / Contingency Fund (**₹30,000 crore**)

boxes.title: Control terms & charged items
items: **Policy cut** = **₹1**; **Token cut** = **₹100**; Economy cut = stated amount
Vote on account: ~**two months**; **3-5 months** in election years
Charged (**Art. 112(3)**): President, Speaker, debt charges, **CAG**, UPSC, **SC judges**

boxes.title: Budget 2026-27 highlights
items: **1 February 2026** (Sunday), **Nirmala Sitharaman**; =="**Yuva Shakti-driven Budget**"==, three Kartavyas
Expenditure **₹53,47,315 crore**; FD **4.3%**; debt **55.6%**; capex **₹12.22 lakh crore**
Defence highest: **₹7,84,678 crore**; **VB-G RAM G** **₹95,692 crore**
**New Income-tax Act, 2025** from **1 April 2026**; MAT **15% → 14%**; no slab change
Rupee from: borrowings **24**, income tax **21**; to: States **22**, interest **20**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Sequence: Revenue → Tax → Non-tax → Capital receipts (APPSC-GS 2025)
Most budgets: **Morarji Desai** (**10**); PSU stake sale ≠ revenue receipt
